content.title: How to watch Hofstra vs. Alabama men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 20
content.text: The No. 4 seed Alabama Crimson Tide (23-9) and the No. 13 seed Hofstra Pride (24-10) will meet in the opening round of the NCAA Tournament on Friday at 3:21 p.m. ET. The contest airs on truTV.How to watch Hofstra Pride vs. Alabama Crimson Tide Venue: Benchmark International Arena Time: 3:21 p.m. ET TV: truTV Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Hofstra vs. Alabama odds Spread: Alabama -12.5 (-105), Hofstra +12.5 (-115) Favorite Moneyline: Alabama -820 Underdog Moneyline: Hofstra +524 Total: 159.5 Total Over Odds: -109 Total Under Odds: -114 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Alabama’s +264 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 8.2 points per game) is a result of scoring 91.7 points per game (first in college basketball) while allowing 83.5 per contest (356th in college basketball). Alabama hits 12.7 three-pointers per game (second-most in college basketball) while shooting 35.8% from beyond the arc (74th in college basketball). It is making 4.6 more threes per contest than its opponents, who drain 8.1 per game while shooting 33.5%. Hofstra outscores opponents by 9.5 points per game (posting 75.6 points per game, 180th in college basketball, and conceding 66.1 per contest, 19th in college basketball) and has a +325 scoring differential. Hofstra connects on 9.5 three-pointers per game (51st in college basketball) at a 36.8% rate (32nd in college basketball), compared to the 7.3 per game its opponents make, at a 31.6% rate.
